records.source_text: f us(a)ni Cremgi dmelano dlb p(er) · Jnbarzalona · C[orpu?]rga ro 19½
records.note: Milanese 'cremgi' yarn by the lb convert in Barcelona to about 19.5 rotoli; abraded units, per-lb basis assumed

records.source_text: f us(a)ni nove dlb · tornano · Jndtto Cuogho ro(b)mi 18½
records.note: New 'usani' by the lb convert 'in the said place' (Barcelona) to about 18.5 rotoli

records.source_text: p ony Smel(a)na · ro(b)mi 15 · et mela · p(er) ony · dboru y et oltrero tornano Jbarzal(on)o
records.note: Per ony of Milanese, about 15 rotoli, convert in Barcelona; unit on left uncertain

records.source_text: p ony Slne(a) · tornano Jndtto Cuogho · ro(b)mi 17 Ī 13½
records.note: Per ony of 'Slnea', convert 'in the said place' (Barcelona); reads 'ro 17 to 13½' - range, best single 17

records.source_text: p ony moshelovi a como · ro(b)mi 7½
records.note: Per ony of muslin(?) of Como, about 7.5 rotoli (in Barcelona, by context)

records.source_text: p ony bre(t)ella menove ro(b)mi 15 · d gr(o)ng ro 20
records.note: Per ony of smaller Brescia(?), 15 rotoli; the coarse-grain variant ('d grong') is 20 rotoli

records.source_text: p ony bre(t)ella menove ro(b)mi 15 · d gr(o)ng ro 20
records.note: Coarse-grain ('d grong') variant of the Brescia entry, 20 rotoli

records.source_text: p ony fioren(t)ini dholla pesa · torna Jdtto Cuogho dbarganto ro 17⅞
records.note: Per ony of Florentine 'della pesa', converts 'in the said place' (Barcelona) at about 17.875 rotoli; 17⅞ = 17.875

records.source_text: Algora ... adporto aPisa · lana · s. 2 d. 2 ¼ · sommo
records.note: Export charge to Pisa per sommo of wool; s.2 d.2 1/4 ~ 2.19 soldi; source town Algora

records.source_text: Visello adato lb 800 buone ... adporto · s. 2 ¼ · sommo
records.note: Export charge to Pisa per sommo; town Visello

records.source_text: Cappola/Fredis/Clospigiera ... adporto s. 5 d. 6 · sommo
records.note: s.5 d.6 = 5.5 soldi per sommo; braced group of towns

records.source_text: Goronimo/Penarogia dato lb 650 ... adporto fino aPisa · s. 7 d. 8 · sommo
records.note: s.7 d.8 = 7.67 soldi per sommo; braced group

records.source_text: Orcella dato lb 1000 ... fino aPisa · s. 4 d.
records.note: Export charge per sommo; town Orcella

records.source_text: ...gholo dato lb 200 · sommonali · adporto aPisa · s. 5 · sommo
records.note: Town name partly illegible

records.source_text: Itoro ador lb 400 · buone ... s. 5 · sommo fino aPisa
records.note: town Itoro

records.source_text: Verabello ... adporto s. 6 d. 7 · sommo
records.note: s.6 d.7 = 6.58 soldi per sommo; town Verabello

records.source_text: Portello lb 190 · chattive ... s. 6 · sommo aPisa
records.note: town Portello

records.source_text: Castello forto lb 300 · sommonali ... s. 6 · sommo aPisa
records.note: town Castello forte

records.source_text: Villa fremosa lb 200 · sommonali ... s. 6 · sommo aPisa
records.note: town Villa fremosa (first occurrence)

records.source_text: Calibranso dato lb 500 ... fino aPisa · s. 4 · sommo
records.note: town Calibranso

records.source_text: Batanda dato lb 200 · buone ... al punto aPisa · s. 3 · sommo
records.note: town Batanda

records.source_text: Itono dato lb 300 ... fino aPisa · s. 5 d. 5 ¼ · sommo
records.note: s.5 d.5 1/4 ~ 5.44 soldi per sommo; town Itono

records.source_text: Cenigale dato lb 200 · chattive ... s. 4 a 5 ¼ · sommo
records.note: Range s.4 to s.5 1/4 per sommo; best single value 4; town Cenigale

records.source_text: Galuon lb 200 · chattive · adporto aPisa · s. 4 sommo
records.note: town Galuon

records.source_text: Estabella lb 600 · sommonali ... s. 5 · sommo
records.note: town Estabella

records.source_text: Belleruolosso ave pesa · s. 4 · sommo
records.note: town Belleruolosso

records.source_text: Bonfargos lb 190 · buone ... fino aPisa · s. 4 ¼ · sommo
records.note: town Bonfargos

records.source_text: Lborghinura lb 600 · sommonali ... s. 3 · sommo aPisa
records.note: town Lborghinura

records.source_text: Tenoi lb 200 · buone ... s. 3 · sommo aPisa
records.note: town Tenoi

records.source_text: Cento lb 200 ... fino aPisa · s. 3 · sommo
records.note: town Cento

records.source_text: Clesfomas lb 400 · assay chattive ... fino aPisa · s. 3 · sommo
records.note: town Clesfomas

records.source_text: Villa nueba lb 550 · buone ... s. 3 · sommo fino aPisa
records.note: town Villa nueba

records.source_text: Cargol lb 200 · assay buone ... s. 2 ¼ · sommo aPisa
records.note: town Cargol

records.source_text: Chubrno lb 250 · chattive · adporto fino aPisa · s. 2 ¼ · sommo
records.note: town Chubrno

records.source_text: Villa fremosa lb 250 · chattive ... s. 4 · sommo aPisa
records.note: town Villa fremosa (second occurrence)

records.source_text: Dedlas lb 200 · assay buone · adporto fino aPisa · s. 6 · sommo
records.note: town Dedlas

records.source_text: Villa Confomas lb 300 · chattive ... adporto s. 2 ¼ · sommo fino aPisa
records.note: town Villa Confomas

records.source_text: adporto fino avalanza del 14 sondo (Avontosa, 300 buone)
records.note: Delivered price of good wool at Valencia, 14 soldi per pound; recurring rate for several lots (Onte Arghostimo, Loreo, Assomina, Urebas all at 14).

records.source_text: Ongiana ... per 150 ghomme ... adporto avalanza del 16 b(uo)no
records.note: Delivered price 16 soldi per pound at Valencia.

records.source_text: Ghuandtore ... enghattivo ... adporto avalanza del 15 (and Aformixo disopra: porto avalanza del 15)
records.note: Delivered price 15 soldi per pound at Valencia for bad wool.

records.source_text: Mas ... per 500 ghattive ... adporto apanssola per e contastighone del 18
records.note: Delivered price 18 soldi per pound at Pampalona (Pamplona); several lots at 18 (Vennona, Darbara, Ramotto, Catalogna).

records.source_text: Porto Amorghelbona ... per 400 ghattivissime ... adporto a contastighone del 19
records.note: Delivered price 19 soldi per pound at Pampalona for very bad wool.

records.source_text: Osghervole ... 100 teabuone ... adporto apanssola del 20 (also Vintamoy per 1200 ... del 20)
records.note: Delivered price 20 soldi per pound at Pampalona.

records.source_text: sono ghattive lane e grosse ... esporto poste amaree di 12 sondo s(econd)o gradi
records.note: Intro paragraph: bad coarse wools exported 'poste amare' at 12 soldi per pound according to grade.

records.source_text: ghatalonia per 500 ghattive ... adporto poste amare del 18 da 26
records.note: Catalonia wool, delivered for Valencia 'poste amare' at 18, range up to 26 soldi per pound; lower bound used.

records.source_text: ghastella enpabano ... per avalanza ... como assesa s 7 per redoa
records.note: Castile loads everything for Valencia by sea with a charge of 7 soldi per load/carico (freight/duty, not a unit price).

records.source_text: L(a) quintale d(i) p(er)pignano e mano[?] che quello d(i) Barzalona lb 1 ¼
records.note: Perpignan quintale exceeds the Barcelona quintale by lb 1.25 (i.e. 1 quintale Perpignan = 1 quintale Barcelona + 1.25 libbre); right side is quintale+1.25 lb

records.source_text: L(a) lb 100 grosse [d(i) p(er)pignano(?)] sono lb 129 ... j[n] Barzalona
records.note: 100 libbre grosse = 129 libbre; right-side place (Barcelona) and source attribution partly conjectural; companion phrase mentions reduction in Barcelona

records.source_text: e 8 ▽ va[l]gono g fiorini
records.note: 8 tournois equal [some number of] grossi/fiorini; right quantity illegible/abbreviated

records.source_text: noe d[i] li 100 s[ig]nory to[r]nano[r]o[..] 76 quathy[?]
records.note: 100 signori coins return about 76 units (quathy?) in Barcelona; unit reading uncertain

records.source_text: 114 s[ig]nory d[i] frama[?] fono ad Bolonga 31 g[..]fisso[?]
records.note: 114 signori of France reckoned as 31 at Bologna; right unit illegible

records.source_text: 114 s[ig]nory d[i] frama[?] ... e j[n] Barzalona 80 quthy[?]
records.note: same 114 signori reckoned as 80 units in Barcelona; unit reading uncertain

records.source_text: d lib(re) 98 d'avignone sono quintaria uno a Barzalona
arboma[?] d'avignone fa romo[?] 1 ¼ in Barzalona
records.note: Unit names (arroba / rove) uncertain in the hand

records.source_text: o marcho dllorgho[?]te[?] e onçe 1 in Barzalona
records.note: 1 marco = 1 oz at Barcelona; descriptor after marco illegible

records.source_text: tela orghorda ... croma[?] 6 ¾ d'avignone ... è fa in Barzalona romo[?] 8 d'ess[?] mesura
records.note: Coarse cloth (tela grossa); 6¾ of Avignon makes 8 of Barcelona; should add ~3 grossi more; units uncertain

records.source_text: d lib(re) 84 di pavolj[?] torno[?] in Barzalona quintarj uno
records.note: Heading place 'Pavolj' read as Paris(?); 84 lb = 1 quintal

records.source_text: pany ... ghomporasi in pavolj[?] ono dspesa ... a monpolieri da 9 grosse a Monpolieri
records.note: Transport charge of cloths to Montpellier ~9 grossi; unit of measure implicit

records.source_text: ono vendut a Barzalona da 8 grosse
records.note: Cloth sold at Barcelona at ~8 grossi; the whole finished sold at 17 grossi

records.source_text: tutto fino vendut a Barzalona da 17 grosse
records.note: Whole finished cloth sold at Barcelona at ~17 grossi

records.source_text: chanbra[?] 1 ⅕ d'unga[?] fa in Barzalona lib(re) una
records.note: Hides: 1⅕ (1.2) of lunga = 1 lb at Barcelona; unit 'lunga' uncertain

records.source_text: d libra di Bologna torna a Barzalona onçe 10 ¼ - ⅛ + ½ - ⅛ + ⅖
records.note: Weight: 1 lb Bologna = 10¼ oz at Barcelona, with fractional corrections (−⅛ +½ −⅛ +⅖)

records.source_text: d romo[?] di Bologna fa palmi 2 ¾ a Barzalona ———— 6 ¾ caviçi[?] palmi 5 ⅙
records.note: 1 rove(?) of Bologna = 2¾ palmi at Barcelona; trailing figures 6¾ and cavezzi 5⅙ ambiguous

records.source_text: chome 100 di chondom[?] di Saona sono i(n) Barzalona, rotoli 190 grosse
records.note: Cargo charge fl 15 (fl 12 asked) at Savona mentioned in same entry; left unit/commodity (chondom?) uncertain.

records.source_text: (g)hanna di Saona fa in Barzalona chana ⅔ ⅕ di verga
records.note: Right side written '⅔ ⅕' (two stacked fractions); read as 2/3 + 1/5 ≈ 0.867. Highly uncertain.

records.source_text: di gimtaro della lana torna in pisa, p(er) lo verso di firenze lb 140 i 142 netta
records.note: Range 140-142 lb net; used 140. Quintale of wool reckoned by the Florentine method; quoted in Pisa-Barcelona section.

records.source_text: a libra 1⅕ di firenze torna a Barzalona lb una
chanio[?] uno d amore[?] di firenze torna in Barzalona palmi tre
records.note: Left unit (canio/canna?) and 'd'amore' uncertain; possibly a cloth measure.

records.source_text: lo gimtaro della lana torna in firenze netta lb 140 i 142 chosi dtornare
records.note: Quintale of wool = 140-142 lb net in Florence; used 140.

records.source_text: a libra 100 di marolicha[?] torna a firenze lb 125 di grama[?]
records.note: 'marolicha' likely Mallorca/Majorca; 125 lb gross. Profit g.4 noted on sale at Florence.

records.source_text: libr 100 di Balonga sono in firenze lb 105¼ netto
records.note: Seta d'Almería entry; 105¼ = 105.25 lb net. 'Balonga' treated as Barcelona; 7¼% profit per lb noted.

records.source_text: e cento chan[a] d(i) granada d(i) chandoarj torna J(n)barzalona da 157 ⁊ 155 chā
records.note: range 157 to 155 canne; used 157

records.source_text: ma chosi d(i) apalmj 10 p(er) chanā e l'archanā d(i) granada e p(er)lmj 9
records.note: the cana of Granada equals 9 palmi (vs 10 palmi per cana generally)

records.source_text: e 100 d(o)nne d(i) granada sono J(n)barzalona d(o)nā 175
records.note: donne is a measure of Granada

records.source_text: e l'archanā d(i) granada J(n)barzalona chanā 1 7/20
e libra 100 d(i) granada tornano J(n)barzalona z° 3 ⁊ 11 (con)ne 19 ½ ⁊ ½ d(i)
records.note: figures partly illegible; right value reads 19 1/2 = 19.5; surrounding numerals (3, 11) uncertain

records.source_text: l'archassa d(e)l oro filato e chonno 60 d(i) oro e J(n)barzalona torna onz 54
records.note: archassa (skein) of spun gold reckoned at 60 of gold = 54 once at Barcelona

records.source_text: alibra p̄ d'oviento d(i) granada torna J(n)barzalona onz 10 2/4 d(i) monedj
records.note: 10 2/4 = 10.5 once; reckoned in moneta of balance; partly illegible

records.source_text: La m(er)cantia d(i) genoua e qui J(n)barzalona p(eso)bar(re) 1 ½ d(i) qe d(i) 56 ⁊ uno tochi d(i)e tornano abarzalona p̄ 63 lb
records.note: Genoa merchandise; 56 (plus one tocco) returns to 63 lb at Barcelona; reading uncertain

records.source_text: onne 9 ⅓ d(i) granada fa J(n)barzalona moueḡo uno
records.note: 9 1/3 once of Granada = 1 moueḡo (measure) at Barcelona

records.source_text: Il gentaua d(i) lona[?] abarzalona di fone agranada p̄ j ° libb 190 netta
records.note: quintale of wool reckoned at 190 libbre net; place attribution uncertain

records.source_text: onza d(i) gharbin e tarj 30
records.note: Palermo coinage: 1 onza = 30 tarì

records.source_text: eltarj balo 2 charlinj
records.note: 1 tarì worth 2 carlini

records.source_text: e l'locharlino ⁊ 10 grani
records.note: 1 carlino = 10 grani

records.source_text: aldurbato balo 12 gharbinj e una asp(er) maque
records.note: durbato (ducat?) worth 12 garbini plus one aspro

records.source_text: l'archomē d(i) palermo e chomē 1 ½ d(i)barzalona
records.note: cantaro of Palermo = 1.5 cantara of Barcelona

records.source_text: la gentavj a palarem⟨os⟩ e lb 100 e gentauj 1 ⅗ e d(i)barzalona
records.note: quintale of Palermo = 100 lb; equals 1 3/5 = 1.6 quintali of Barcelona; reading uncertain

records.source_text: ℔ libra 140 sottil oncia 8[?] di Vinegra · fan(n)o · 1° q(ui)ntare · a Barzalona
records.note: Plus 8 once on the left; the once figure is read with lower confidence.

records.source_text: ① onne 16 / o pocho piu di Vinegra · fan(n)o libra una in Barzalona
records.note: "o pocho piu" (or a little more) qualifies the 16 once.

records.source_text: ℔ o marscio[?] di Vinegra · come · 8 ed maggiore · 2 p(er)° che q(ue)llo di Monpolieri[?]
records.note: The Venice marscio/peso is greater by 2 per cent than that of Montpellier; abraded, both numbers (8 and 2) uncertain.

records.source_text: ℔ o peso ⟨dell'auanto⟩ e dellegnoia[?] di Vinegra · e maggiore 12½ p(er)° che q(ue)llo di Barzalona
records.note: Venice peso greater by 12.5 per cent than Barcelona's.

records.source_text: el di grosso · vale · ₰ 24[?]
records.note: Value of the grosso; figure 24 uncertain.

records.source_text: 36 di Valenza · fanetto[?] a Vinegra · migliano[?] 1° · e q(ui)ne[?] · e ℔ 35½ a 35½ //
records.note: Heavily abraded; 36 of Valencia make 1 migliaio at Venice, with a libbre 35.5 figure (range stated as 35.5 to 35.5).

records.source_text: ② ana in pany[?] · il c(en)° grosso · fa · in Balanza · ogni 11 · di ℔ 120 q(ui)ntaro ... vendendole a Valanza · ₰ 105 · redipro[?] · da · 2[?] · p(er)°
records.note: Quintaro at Valencia = lb 120; selling price d. 105, yielding about 2 per cent. Highly abraded.

records.source_text: che ℔ 400 sottili / e l'altre firiena[?] ... aleuzalona · Hcho[?] ℔ 79 · di Barzalona
records.note: "papa" (Pope's wax?) sealed, lb 400 light reckoned as lb 79 at Barcelona; reading very uncertain.

records.source_text: ℔ onnia di Gaeta[?] sia · 30 tary · el tary · e 10 g[rani]
records.note: Money of account of Gaeta: 1 oncia = 30 tarì.

records.source_text: el tary · e 10 g[rani]
records.note: 1 tarì = 10 grani.

records.source_text: 100 grani · vale · ₰₰ 1°
records.note: 100 grani worth 1 florin.

records.source_text: el grano · vale · 2 tornesi
records.note: 1 grano = 2 tornesi.

records.source_text: o / 60 grani · vale l'onna[?]
records.note: Alternative reckoning: 60 grani worth the oncia.

records.source_text: ℔ grani 99 fa · in mauergo[?] a Barzalona · sele vale · verga · ₰₰ 96 Barzalonesi
records.note: 99 grani reckoned at Barcelona = a verga worth 96 Barcelonese; reading uncertain.

records.source_text: e lb 95 abruggia fono inbarzalona q(ui)ntaro uno
records.note: Stated alongside lb 100 (of Bruges) at the start of the line; the conversion equates 95 lb Bruges to 1 quintar Barcelona.

records.source_text: doi[?] 1° quintaro lb 100 fono 117 ... stagni chmile chose
records.note: A quintar of 100 lb (of Majorca) makes 117 at Barcelona; applies to tin (stagni) and similar goods.

records.source_text: e 100 chomo dmaiolicha fono abarzalona rome[?] 102
records.note: 100 units of Majorca = 102 at Barcelona; the unit terms (chomo / rame) are read with low confidence.

records.source_text: e l'grosso vale 1° d(en)ari[?]
records.note: Value of the grosso coin stated as 1 denaro; quoted in the Bruges-Barcelona context.

records.source_text: cera chon(per)ata dmaiolicha e p 15 lb 82[?] torna abarzalona e p 16 lb 5
records.note: Wax bought at Majorca at 'p 15 lb 82' returns/becomes at Barcelona 'p 16 lb 5'. Meaning of the 'p' measure and the exact reading of the weights are uncertain; included as a Majorca->Barcelona equivalence for wax.

records.source_text: sogghono valare tt[?] 4 i 6 ladggina
records.note: Range lb. 4 to 6 per dozen; used low end 4. Reading of unit (libbre) and 'ladggina'=la dozzina uncertain.

records.source_text: sogghono valare disuno tt[?] 5 daffi 12 p(er) 13
records.note: 'ontaly' lamb-wools worth lb. 5 each ('disuno'=of one). Units uncertain.

records.source_text: vala ladggina tt[?] 8 i 12 i(n) maiolicha disuna
records.note: 'astrogma' 6-month lambskins, dozen worth lb. 8 to 12 in Mallorca; used low end 8.

records.source_text: ssoy resembri amanolicha brundnisi aquintare barberescho che libre 117 e amanolicha epeso dromana
records.note: Hides ('essembri') reckoned at Majorca: 1 quintal Barbary reckoning = about 117 libbre; weight per the 'Romana' system by fifths. Origin Brindisi(?) conjectural.

records.source_text: ssghasspo dburch dtortosa torna t amanolicha qatetny 7 ¼
records.note: The 'ssghasspo' of weight of Tortosa converts at Majorca to cantar 7¼. Left unit name abraded.

records.source_text: e inque sessory damaresilca sono amanolicha qatetny 7 ¼
records.note: The 'inque sessory' of Marseille = cantar 7¼ at Majorca. Left unit name abraded.

records.source_text: asalma quenorale danha ch 16 tornak torna amanolicha qatetny 3 ¾
records.note: A 'salma generale' of Danha(?), being 16 [...], converts at Majorca to cantar 3¾. Source place (Danha?) and the '16' qualifier unclear; from_place set to Majorca as quoting market.

records.source_text: ehno dno alsole drcunya torna amanolicha qatetny 10 ¼ e peso qtory 33 ⊺ 39
records.note: The 'dno' 'of the sun' of Drcunya(?) converts at Majorca to cantar 10¼; weight by fifths(?) range 33-39. Place and unit heavily abraded.

records.source_text: borionasi lqantarse delte come torna Jnfirenze libre cento corth netto
records.note: The cantar of the said (Minorca) wools converts at Florence to lb. 100 net.

records.source_text: come Sibilia un cahisso che 12 faneghe
records.note: Internal Seville dry measure: 1 cahiz = 12 fanegas (salt).

records.source_text: e ogni fanega fa 12 salermini (almudi)
records.note: Internal Seville subdivision: 1 fanega = 12 almuds; unit name partly abbreviated.

records.source_text: e questo cahisso fa a Barzalona quartini sove[?]
records.note: Cahiz of Seville salt to Barcelona quartini; right_qty (~9) is uncertain (reading 'sove'/possibly 'nove').

records.source_text: e di Firenze torna detto cahisso sona vintidue
records.note: 1 cahiz of Seville salt = 22 (staia) at the Florence measure; right_unit inferred (staio).

records.source_text: C sgasso d valenza d tornare a bonzalona quartini 2÷
records.note: Valencia dry measure to Barcelona = 2.5 quartini; left unit term heavily abbreviated.

records.source_text: el sgasso d valenza d tornare in firenze sona otto
records.note: Valencia dry measure = 8 (staia) in Florence; right_unit inferred.

records.source_text: E detto modio di Bya di sale torna in Pisa alla misura di Firenze sona 90 e 92
records.note: Modio of Ibiza salt reckoned at the Florence measure (taken at Pisa) ~90-92; used 90 as best single value, range noted.

records.source_text: P pepe sileant[?] asporta rutoli 900 torna abarzalona vale ra(ti) 7 ⅛
records.note: Pepper: 900 rotoli of Alexandria exported, returns/valued at 7 1/8 'rati' at Barcelona; heavily abbreviated and partly damaged, unit 'rati' uncertain.

records.source_text: amena[?] fa Jnbarzalona onze 22
records.note: An 'amena/mena' measure of Alexandria makes 22 ounces at Barcelona; left quantity (presumably 1) not explicit in damaged text.

records.source_text: adina[?] amena[?] cha lib 18 on 9 abarzalona
records.note: 'Adina amena' equals 18 libbre 9 once at Barcelona (18 lb 9 oz); left quantity not explicit; right_qty gives the libbre figure (18) with 9 once additional.

records.source_text: J yndarso[?] sono manatto[?] dalessandria fa lib z lib 11 netto d(e)habella[?] abarzato[?]
records.note: An Alexandria measure of 'yndarso' makes 11 libbre net (of tare) at Barcelona; preceding 'lib z' unresolved; left quantity not explicit.

records.source_text: L o gintare[?] ddomaskho e 100 ṟuotoli / o(n)ne 12 chol(on)na
records.note: Defines the Damascus kintar as 100 ruotoli, at 12 once to the colonna. Local Damascus measure definition.

records.source_text: C o piṉzo[?] è fa palmi 2 3/5 abarzalona
records.note: 1 pinzo of Damascus = 2 3/5 (2.6) palmi at Barcelona.

records.source_text: di̱uotoli fa 'nbarzalona o(n)ne 9
records.note: Ruotolo of Damascus makes 9 once at Barcelona; surrounding text heavily abbreviated/doubtful.

records.source_text: I lguntaṟy[?] abovenṯas[?] e maggio̱re ⅕ è que̱llo ddomaskho
records.note: The kintar (of Barcelona/abovente) is greater by 1/5 than that of Damascus; expressed as ratio 1.2:1.

records.source_text: L o ṟuotolo de o(n)ne 5 p(er)c(ento) è ṯoṟa fa lib 4½
records.note: Ruotolo with 5% tare makes 4.5 lb; reading of unit/place doubtful, likely a Barcelona equivalence.

records.source_text: pani fiorentini ... d(e)la torça d(e)rono af 68 ī 70 la pizza
records.note: first grade; range 68 to 70 florins per piece, low value used

records.source_text: d(e)la sergonda af 75 ī 78 pizza
records.note: second grade; range 75 to 78 florins per piece, low value used

records.source_text: d(e)la oytima d(e)rono af 75 ī 78 p(er)
records.note: best grade (ottima); range 75 to 78 florins per piece, low value used

records.source_text: ciera do 13 chontora
records.note: wax at 13 per hundredweight; unit/currency uncertain

records.source_text: pani d(e)sere belli onfolorati ... do 2 roma
records.note: at 2 per 'roma'; reading tentative

records.source_text: ciera filata doble 19 il uotolo

records.note: The 'inque sessory' of Marseille = cantar 7¼ at Majorca. Left unit name abraded.

records.source: espory tre dim<a>rsilha [marsiglia?] Jnees [?] eficogns forno ony una digenoba
records.note: three spice-units of Marseille(?) make 1 oncia of Genoa; reading uncertain

records.source: d ogno uno dim<a>ursia [Marsiglia] disp(in)ato Jagenoba sie ony 3 1/8
records.note: one 'ogno' of Marseille = ounces 3 1/8 at Genoa

records.source: lomarcho dellariento dimessina ... onçe 8 ll torna Jnfirenze onçe 7 d(enari) 12
records.note: Marco of silver of Messina = 8 once; converts in Florence to 7 once 12 denari (7.5 once)

records.source: torna Jngienova onçe 8 d(enari) 1
records.note: Marco of silver Messina (8 once) converts in Genoa to 8 once 1 denaro

records.source: f us(a)ni Cremgi dmelano dlb p(er) · Jnbarzalona · C[orpu?]rga ro 19½
records.note: Milanese 'cremgi' yarn by the lb convert in Barcelona to about 19.5 rotoli; abraded units, per-lb basis assumed

records.source: f us(a)ni nove dlb · tornano · Jndtto Cuogho ro(b)mi 18½
records.note: New 'usani' by the lb convert 'in the said place' (Barcelona) to about 18.5 rotoli

records.source: p ony Smel(a)na · ro(b)mi 15 · et mela · p(er) ony · dboru y et oltrero tornano Jbarzal(on)o
records.note: Per ony of Milanese, about 15 rotoli, convert in Barcelona; unit on left uncertain

records.source: p ony Slne(a) · tornano Jndtto Cuogho · ro(b)mi 17 Ī 13½
records.note: Per ony of 'Slnea', convert 'in the said place' (Barcelona); reads 'ro 17 to 13½' - range, best single 17

records.source: e lib(re) 100 da melano tornano · in firenze · lib(re) 98
records.note: 100 lb Milan = 98 lb Florence

records.source: borionasi lqantarse delte come torna Jnfirenze libre cento corth netto
records.note: The cantar of the said (Minorca) wools converts at Florence to lb. 100 net.

records.source: jnmonolieri silvande algima chose argontorie barbaresche · torna jnfir(enze) lb 140
records.note: Montpellier Barbary silver wares convert to Florence lb 140

records.source: ℔ grani 99 fa · in mauergo[?] a Barzalona · sele vale · verga · ₰₰ 96 Barzalonesi
records.note: 99 grani reckoned at Barcelona = a verga worth 96 Barcelonese; reading uncertain.

records.source: in chantare di Napoli della torna in Firenze lb 290
records.note: One cantar of Naples converts to 290 libbre at Florence; reading of place 'Napoli' carries some reservation in the edition.

records.source: comare(n)go è (e)l medesimo peso ch(e) torna [i]n Firenze onne 8 d(e)n 12
records.note: Pearl/gold caratto weight equated to 8 once 12 denari in Florence; left side unit unclear. Right value = 8 once 12 denari (8.5 once).

records.source: l'archomē d(i) palermo e chomē 1 ½ d(i)barzalona
records.note: cantaro of Palermo = 1.5 cantara of Barcelona

records.source: la gentavj a palarem⟨os⟩ e lb 100 e gentauj 1 ⅗ e d(i)barzalona
records.note: quintale of Palermo = 100 lb; equals 1 3/5 = 1.6 quintali of Barcelona; reading uncertain

records.source: d lib(re) 84 di pavolj[?] torno[?] in Barzalona quintarj uno
records.note: Heading place 'Pavolj' read as Paris(?); 84 lb = 1 quintal

records.source: ondansi seta[?] alibbra· torna ɉdmoroia· onno· 16¾ // afiyamba[?] ơn 16¼
records.note: Silk sold by the libbra, converts to 16¾ once; 16¼ once at Flanders.

records.source: L(a) quintale d(i) p(er)pignano e mano[?] che quello d(i) Barzalona lb 1 ¼
records.note: Perpignan quintale exceeds the Barcelona quintale by lb 1.25 (i.e. 1 quintale Perpignan = 1 quintale Barcelona + 1.25 libbre); right side is quintale+1.25 lb

records.source: L(a) lb 100 grosse [d(i) p(er)pignano(?)] sono lb 129 ... j[n] Barzalona
records.note: 100 libbre grosse = 129 libbre; right-side place (Barcelona) and source attribution partly conjectural; companion phrase mentions reduction in Barcelona

records.source: di gimtaro della lana torna in pisa, p(er) lo verso di firenze lb 140 i 142 netta
records.note: Range 140-142 lb net; used 140. Quintale of wool reckoned by the Florentine method; quoted in Pisa-Barcelona section.

records.source: crenogio digrano diroma sono 8 ½ ※ 9 sona difirenze ※ ragionalo sona 8 ¾
records.note: Rome grain measure = 8.5 to 9 sona Florence; reckoned at 8.75

records.source: d voglio uno deroma Jagenoba ony 1 7/8
records.note: one 'voglio/vegghio' of Rome = ounces 1 7/8 at Genoa

records.source: melano · sichanbia · f.p. j° d'chamera · chontra · f.p. dl 32 · dnp(re)ciachi
records.note: Cambio: Milan exchanges 1 papal florin of the Chamber against fl. 32 imperiali. Reading f.p. = fiorino papale/di camera.

records.source: chroma · chsapalmj 8 · torna · infirenze ... hollanchona[?] · dfirenze · ka palmj 9 ¼
records.note: Length: a Roman canna of 8 palmi converts to Florence; the said palmi reckoned at 9¼ by the Florentine braccio. Very garbled; numbers (8 palmi, 9¼) tentative.

records.source: chome 100 di chondom[?] di Saona sono i(n) Barzalona, rotoli 190 grosse
records.note: Cargo charge fl 15 (fl 12 asked) at Savona mentioned in same entry; left unit/commodity (chondom?) uncertain.

records.source: (g)hanna di Saona fa in Barzalona chana ⅔ ⅕ di verga
records.note: Right side written '⅔ ⅕' (two stacked fractions); read as 2/3 + 1/5 ≈ 0.867. Highly uncertain.

records.source: e questo cahisso fa a Barzalona quartini sove[?]
records.note: Cahiz of Seville salt to Barcelona quartini; right_qty (~9) is uncertain (reading 'sove'/possibly 'nove').

records.source: e di Firenze torna detto cahisso sona vintidue
records.note: 1 cahiz of Seville salt = 22 (staia) at the Florence measure; right_unit inferred (staio).

records.source: harfissi xxiij disibilia tornato infirenze e dipesa sromolo xxv alfonti no torna(no) amme 4 ¾
records.note: 23 harfissi Seville = 25 staia (Alfonsine); reading uncertain

records.source: chibr uso disibilia tornano infirenze lb 190
records.note: Hides by use of Seville convert in Florence to 190 lb

records.source: chepesa onre otto e questo moveso tornerebbe infirenze verso onre 7 ½
records.note: 8 once Seville = about 7.5 once Florence

records.source: d hariso [Arezzo?] uno disibilia sono ony g 5/4 genoba
records.note: one 'hariso' of Seville = ounces 5/4 (1.25) of Genoa

records.source: Cibilia silvande aro(no)[?] gentiluomine calibre · torna dreto agentiluomer · dj fir(enze) lb 126
records.note: Seville gentleman-grade gold/measure converts back to Florence lb 126; left unit is the grade, not a clean quantity

records.source: d(e)tto g(enti)lome · torna jnle(n)mecna[?] a lb 196[?]
records.note: Said grade converts at lb 196; destination place (Lemecna / Lombardia?) and number uncertain

records.source: jnsibilia silvande astiento (estagno) jnpiastre · almavet[?] g(e)t[?] u(n)a jnfir(enze) onçe 8 d̄ 2[?]
records.note: One Seville unit of tin = Florence 8 once 2 denari; right_qty given as 8 once 2 denari approx 8.17 once

records.source: ssghasspo dburch dtortosa torna t amanolicha qatetny 7 ¼
records.note: The 'ssghasspo' of weight of Tortosa converts at Majorca to cantar 7¼. Left unit name abraded.

records.source: 36 di Valenza · fanetto[?] a Vinegra · migliano[?] 1° · e q(ui)ne[?] · e ℔ 35½ a 35½ //
records.note: Heavily abraded; 36 of Valencia make 1 migliaio at Venice, with a libbre 35.5 figure (range stated as 35.5 to 35.5).

records.source: C sgasso d valenza d tornare a bonzalona quartini 2÷
records.note: Valencia dry measure to Barcelona = 2.5 quartini; left unit term heavily abbreviated.

records.source: el sgasso d valenza d tornare in firenze sona otto
records.note: Valencia dry measure = 8 (staia) in Florence; right_unit inferred.

records.source: ℔ libra 140 sottil oncia 8[?] di Vinegra · fan(n)o · 1° q(ui)ntare · a Barzalona
records.note: Plus 8 once on the left; the once figure is read with lower confidence.

records.source: ① onne 16 / o pocho piu di Vinegra · fan(n)o libra una in Barzalona
records.note: "o pocho piu" (or a little more) qualifies the 16 once.

records.source: ℔ o marscio[?] di Vinegra · come · 8 ed maggiore · 2 p(er)° che q(ue)llo di Monpolieri[?]
records.note: The Venice marscio/peso is greater by 2 per cent than that of Montpellier; abraded, both numbers (8 and 2) uncertain.

records.source: ℔ o peso ⟨dell'auanto⟩ e dellegnoia[?] di Vinegra · e maggiore 12½ p(er)° che q(ue)llo di Barzalona
records.note: Venice peso greater by 12.5 per cent than Barcelona's.

records.source: che ℔ 400 sottili / e l'altre firiena[?] ... aleuzalona · Hcho[?] ℔ 79 · di Barzalona
records.note: "papa" (Pope's wax?) sealed, lb 400 light reckoned as lb 79 at Barcelona; reading very uncertain.
